description:
A local-first workspace for teams of AI agents.

Autohand Squad is a local-first workspace for agent teams. It runs a local runtime, desktop controller, analytics, and release pipeline so you can work with your dream team of AI agents.
Stable release. Recommended for everyone.
Source: a364cdc2887c
What's new
Added
- Edit a member's profile from your iPhone. Squad for iPhone shows a member's profile when you select it, and Edit changes its name, role, description and instructions here on this computer. An edit made on the phone and one made here never overwrite each other unseen: whichever arrives second is asked to look again.
- Phones through iCloud (preview, off by default). Squad can carry your paired iPhone's messages through your own iCloud when Wi-Fi and the relay can't reach this Mac, with no Autohand server in between. It appears as a fourth switch, Through iCloud, in Settings › Computers only in builds that include the Squad iCloud helper; current builds don't, and nothing changes for them. It needs the same Apple Account on both devices and has not yet been tried against real iCloud.
Changed
- The pen on a member's card (click the member's name at the top of a chat) now opens its profile with Edit Profile ready. Hovering the member's face shows a pen: click the face to change the avatar.
Fixed
- A newer release is no longer hidden behind an older download. If you downloaded an update and opened its installer, then a newer version came out, Squad kept saying "Installer opened" and "Open installer again" reopened the older version. Squad now says the newer version is available and downloads it, Settings › Updates and the sidebar say "Version 0.1.24 is available" while the installer is open, and "The update didn't finish" offers to download the newer version instead of retrying the old one. Copies older than this fix still need the installer from the release page once.
